traitLines: Trash Talker|{He} has never had an unspoken thought and never will.
Devout|{He} prays before every fight, after every fight, and occasionally during.
Party Animal|{He} treats every win like New Year's Eve and every loss like a different New Year's Eve.
Hothead|{His} temper has been banned from three Applebee's.
Conspiracy Poster|{His} social feed is 40% training clips and 60% 'do your own research'.
Business Savvy|{He} reads {his} own contracts, which already puts {him} ahead of most of the roster.
Loyal|{He} has turned down bigger offers out of loyalty, which {his} manager hates.
Mercenary|Loyalty is a word {he} has seen in a dictionary and found unconvincing.
Shy|{He} gives one-word interviews and fights like a ten-paragraph essay.
Showman|{His} walkouts have choreography. {His} press conferences have costume changes.
Family First|{His} kids' recital comes before any fight camp, a fact {his} coach has learned the hard way.
Reckless Driver|{He} owns three cars and four speeding tickets per car.
Gambler|{He} bet on {himself} once and has not stopped betting on anything since.
Crypto Bro|{He} will explain the blockchain to you whether you asked or not.
Political|{He} posts opinions about elections in countries {he} cannot find on a map.
Prankster|{He} once filled a teammate's car with packing peanuts the day before a title fight.
Perfectionist|{He} rewatches {his} wins to find mistakes, and finds them.
Injury Prone|{His} medical file needs its own filing cabinet.
Paranoid|{He} thinks {his} sparring partners are spies. Some of them are.
Wholesome|{He} volunteers at an animal shelter and apologizes to opponents after knocking them out.
Streamer|{He} streams training, meals, and the occasional mental breakdown.
Clout Chaser|{He} has never met a camera {he} didn't want to fight in front of.
Gym Rat|{He} sleeps at the gym. Not as a metaphor. There's a cot.
Diva|{He} has a rider for weigh-ins. It includes a specific brand of coconut water.
Lazy|{His} cardio is a rumor and {his} fight camps are a suggestion.
Addictive Personality|Anything {he} likes, {he} likes too much.
Mentor|{He} coaches the kids' class for free and the kids adore {him}.
Weight Misser|{He} has missed weight so often the scale has a restraining order.
Reformed|{He} has turned {his} life around, and won't stop telling you about it.
Martyr Complex|Everyone is out to get {him}. Sometimes they really are.
Sober|{He} is sober now and drinks an alarming amount of sparkling water.
